$comment: Source of truth for the agent tools of `bun mcp`. src/codegen/generate-agent-tools.ts derives src/agent_tools/generated/tools.rs, docs/project/agent-tools.mdx and the bun-deps skill from this file; lib.rs binds each name to its implementation.
title: Agent tools
description: Native tools of `bun mcp` for coding agents: digest a directory and read the installed sources and docs of a project's dependencies, offline and at their exact versions.

tools.name: git_ingest
tools.title: Directory digest
tools.description: Turn a local directory or a subpath of it into a prompt-ready digest in the GitIngest layout: a summary, the directory tree and the content of every text file. Honors .gitignore, skips binary files and files over max_file_size.

source.description: Directory to ingest, absolute or relative to the working directory. Defaults to the working directory.

subpath.description: Subdirectory of source to restrict the digest to.

include_patterns.description: Glob patterns a file must match, e.g. "*.rs" or "src/**/*.ts".

exclude_patterns.description: Glob patterns to skip, on top of .gitignore.

max_file_size.description: Largest file to include, in bytes. Default 10485760.

max_total_bytes.description: Stop adding file contents past this many bytes. Default 16777216.

tools.name: deps_list
tools.title: List dependencies
tools.description: List the dependencies of a project whose sources are on disk: npm packages from package.json resolved through node_modules, Cargo packages from Cargo.lock resolved in the Cargo registry and git checkouts, and directories under vendor/. Each entry has its ecosystem, version and local path.

root.description: Project root. Defaults to the working directory.

filter.description: Case-insensitive substring the name must contain.

tools.name: deps_info
tools.title: Dependency facts
tools.description: Facts about one dependency read from its installed manifest: version, local path, license, repository, homepage, description and the documentation files it ships.

name.description: Package, crate or vendor directory name.

root.description: Project root. Defaults to the working directory.

ecosystem.description: Disambiguate when the name exists in several ecosystems.

tools.name: deps_tree
tools.title: Dependency tree
tools.description: List a directory of a dependency's installed sources.

name.description: Package, crate or vendor directory name.

path.description: Directory inside the dependency. Defaults to its root.

root.description: Project root. Defaults to the working directory.

tools.name: deps_read
tools.title: Read a dependency file
tools.description: Read one file of a dependency's installed sources. Text past max_bytes is cut and the result is flagged truncated.

name.description: Package, crate or vendor directory name.

path.description: File inside the dependency, e.g. "README.md" or "src/lib.rs".

offset.description: Byte offset to start at. Default 0.

root.description: Project root. Defaults to the working directory.

tools.name: deps_search
tools.title: Search dependency sources
tools.description: Regular-expression search over the installed sources of one or more dependencies, in parallel. Returns file, line and the matching line.

glob.description: Only search files matching these globs.

root.description: Project root. Defaults to the working directory.

tools.name: deps_docs
tools.title: Search dependency documentation
tools.description: Rank the documentation shipped by installed dependencies (README, *.md, *.mdx, docs/, *.d.ts) against a query and return the best sections. Offline counterpart of a web documentation search, pinned to the installed versions.

names.description: Restrict to these dependencies. Defaults to every npm and vendor dependency.

root.description: Project root. Defaults to the working directory.
